issues.description: The problem statement text instructs students to implement the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) as public for easier testing, but the UML in the same problem statement marks singFarmSongVerse as private (minus sign). Both the template and the provided solution implement singFarmSongVerse as private in Farm.java. This inconsistency between the textual instruction, the UML, and the code may confuse students about the required visibility and could cause test access issues if tests expect a public method.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility contradiction by choosing one consistent intent: either (A) update the problem statement text to match the UML and code (state that singFarmSongVerse should be private), or (B) change the template and solution Farm.java to declare singFarmSongVerse as public (and update any method calls/tests accordingly). Prefer making the problem statement and UML consistent; if tests require direct access, make the method public in both template and solution and update the UML to show a public method.
